maya: Quick check — planning a small QA inference run tomorrow 09:00 UTC in eu-west1, ~2h, needs H100 (or closest). Anyone know standby slot availability from vendor-3? cc @kai @ops-bot
kai: We currently show 2 standby slots in eu-west1 but one is flagged 'firmware_hold'. Vendor-3 ETA on clearance ~4h if they prioritize. :thinking:
priya: If firmware_hold persists, is eu-west2 A100 an OK fallback? latency won't be great but acceptable for QA.
alex: eu-west2 A100 is available today for a 2h window. Cross-region routing should be fine, but watch bandwidth egress costs.
jordan: Also check project quota for GPU cores — some tests are under a diff project with a lower quota.
ops-bot: Reservation status for vendor-3 eu-west1: standby_slots=2, firmware_hold=1, last_vendor_update="2026-03-17T21:14Z", can_force-priority=true (owner: vendor-ops)
maya: Thanks. @kai can you ask vendor-ops to prioritize firmware clearance? If not, let's plan fallback to eu-west2 A100 and I'll update the test matrix.
kai: Yep, pinged vendor-ops (ticket #V3-462). ETA message from them: "aiming for 6-8h, can expedite to ~3-4h with priority." I'll post updates here.
priya: FYI finance wanted a head's up on cross-region egress for the run — could be ~$20 for the window, not huge but shout if it grows.
alex: If we end up using eu-west2, I'll flip the routing flag on canary config: `infra.playback.region_fallback = true` — will DM PR for review.
maya: Perfect. Plan: wait 2h for vendor update, then cutover to eu-west2 A100 if still blocked. @jordan could you confirm quota on the test project (compute.gpu.allowed)?
jordan: Confirmed: test-project has quota for 4 GPU cores in eu-west2, so a single A100 instance fits. I'll raise a tiny quota request if we need more later.
maya: Awesome — I'll schedule window and post an invite. Thanks all :thumbsup:
kai: Update: vendor-ops replied, expediting to ~3h. I'll close the loop.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: run-ticket created #RUN-9821, owner maya, window 2026-03-18T09:00Z-11:00Z.
maya: Closing this thread — will re-open if vendor slips. :wave:
